source_refs.locator: Printed p. 56, section 4.2.1, coastal-protection implementation status.

uncertainty: 2025 review summarizing earlier coastal studies; not a current 2026 flood census or an evaluated wetland loss-reduction effect.

source_refs.locator: Printed p. 56, section 4.2.1, Nuku'alofa high-tide inundation paragraph citing ADB (2019).

uncertainty: 2090 projection relayed from ADB 2019, with scenario unspecified in the quoted summary. Not current inundation or inevitable abandonment.
